articles.title: Philly's Biggest Stars Are Throwing a Free July 4th Party — and You're Invited!
articles.summary: Imagine a free concert with Christina Aguilera, Will Smith, and the Roots, right by the Liberty Bell! On July 4th, Philadelphia's Benjamin Franklin Parkway turns into a giant stage for America's 250th birthday. Fireworks will light up the sky at 11:45 p.m.

articles.title: Why Is Clean Water Still a Problem in Some Countries?
articles.summary: About 2 billion people don't have regular access to clean drinking water. A new study found that in many countries, democracies are actually falling behind non-democracies at providing safe water. The reason might surprise you: safe water is invisible, so politicians don't get credit for it.

articles.title: Zap That Grime! The Best Electric Pressure Washers for Summer Cleaning
articles.summary: Get your deck and driveway sparkling with an electric pressure washer! These machines are light, quiet, and super easy to use — just plug in and spray. Our top pick is the Greenworks 2700-PSI model, which cleans fast and even has a soap tank.
